about_the_game:
The Secret World-Core Setting-SWADE

An age is ending, and the darkest days are already here. Ancient enemies cast their avaricious gaze upon our world, threats both mortal and cosmic-once thought merely myth, but horrifically all too real-reveal themselves as the clock counts down towards apocalypse. Now, the "Bees," the Chosen of Gaia, must step forth to defend the Earth against these dire threats. At the same time, they must work with secret societies who support the bees in their efforts to save humanity from unspeakable horrors.</p> <p> In The Secret World: The Roleplaying Game, the players are those bees. The Secret World role-playing game is an adaptation and continuation of Funcom's iconic MMORPG. This game uses the Savage Worlds (SWADE) ruleset.

Inside this book, you will find rules for creating bees, running the game, and more:

  • Rules for working with the secret societies: the Dragon, the Templars, and the Illuminati

  • Rules for the unique ability of bees to escape what would normally be a final death

  • An expansive look at the setting of the Secret World, the important movers and shakers, and the threats who lurk in the shadows.

  • Gamemaster advice on how to use the conspiracies of the real world to build adventures for The Secret World.

The Secret World awaits... do you have the courage to face its dangers?
